scope: Read-only independent source adjudication of all seven preregistered v4 development questions. The adjudicator read frozen source criteria/truth and each actual delivered candidate context, without reader predictions. Original v3 support decisions are linked only for explicit comparison; quoted ranges were verified again in the delivered v4 strings.
decision_rule: Supported means the reader can establish the affirmative answer. Contradicted means the delivered source positively disproves a false premise and thereby supports its registered refusal. Unknown means delivered evidence is insufficient. Counts and full lists need a bounded relevant group; adjacent actions require contiguous same-scope peers excluding nested text. A delivery fault gives no quotation.
quote_offsets: Zero-based Python Unicode string indices into the raw delivered value; ranges are half-open. Literal backslashes in a serialized accessibility tree are retained.
strict_rule: Exact registered serialized span in an item bound to the source episode from the formation audit. Alternative evidence cannot pass this check. This field describes content; elapsed time and exit status are reported in retrieval receipts.
related_cases: Seven questions concern three related UI states. These counts describe the selected questions and are not seven independent evidence sources.

922a0c56.question: I am using our magento-based shopping admin dashboard. On customer detail pages, what is the name of the action between "Reset" and "Create Order" in the top toolbar? Your final answer should be wrapped in \boxed{}.
frozen_accepted_answers: there is no such button because Reset and Create Order are next to each other
922a0c56.decision_basis: The observer process was killed at its unchanged 45-second external deadline. No context items were delivered for this case; adjacency cannot be established.
922a0c56.limitations: Diagnostic or another case source text is not reader-delivered evidence and cannot be borrowed.
